description: Product photos for marketplaces, one image per size, since most marketplaces want the same thing: a near-white border is trimmed, then the product is centred at the size’s fill. square 2000×2000 (85%) for Amazon, eBay, Shopify, Google Shopping, Facebook Marketplace, Depop, Mercari, Poshmark; portrait 1080×1350 (4:5, 75%) for Instagram Shop and Vinted; landscape 2000×1600 (5:4, 75%) for Etsy. Pick sizes, or name marketplaces and their sizes are used. Works best with products shot on white; the photo’s own background is kept (removing it needs Cutout on one.design). Saved next to the originals as name-<size>.jpg (name-square.jpg). [Pro tool.]

background.description: "white" (pure white, what most marketplaces want for the main image) or a hex colour.

files.description: Image files or folders (a folder means the images in it). ~ is your home folder.

fill_percent.description: How much of the frame the product fills along its limiting side, the same for every marketplace. Default: each marketplace’s own.

marketplaces.description: Instead of sizes: marketplaces to make images for; each one’s size is used (Amazon and eBay share the square).

output_dir.description: Folder to save results in. Default: next to each original. Originals are never overwritten.

sizes.description: Sizes to make: square, portrait, landscape. Default: all three (unless marketplaces is given).

trim.description: Trim the near-white border round the product first.
